mentions.name: Gymlocity
mentions.description: All-in-one gym management platform for small gym owners, covering class scheduling, member booking, Stripe payments, and workout programming. Built with a React 19 + Vite frontend, ASP.NET Core 10 API, and PostgreSQL, using a multi-tenant architecture so each gym gets its own branded experience. Currently polishing the member dashboard and workout tracking UI, with the goal of a setup a solo trainer can complete in an afternoon without sales calls or demos.
mentions.problem: Big players like Mindbody are overkill and expensive for small gyms, and most gym software ignores workout programming, leaving trainers to rely on spreadsheets or generic apps.
mentions.audience: Personal trainers with home gyms and small 1-2 location owner-operated gym facilities.
